name: scRNA-seq GRN benchmarking
description: Evaluates and compares gene regulatory network inference algorithms on single-cell transcriptomic data using standardized metrics and datasets.
evaluation_method: AUPR (area under the precision-recall curve) and AUROC; primary: AUPR
reputation: Well-regarded within the computational biology community as a standardized way to compare GRN inference methods, but mainly used by domain specialists.
notes: Often evaluated on small or simulation-derived datasets; results sensitive to class imbalance and choice of gold-standard; benchmark is non-LLM and focused on network/graph metrics.
